description: EXT3 NF-M1 closure: per-row flip-identity QC on the committed 8.47M-row chirality catalog (p4_chirality.parquet). Flip-pass probabilities recovered via p_flip = 2*p_eq - p_raw per channel (channel-swapped: p_CCW^flip = 2 p_CW^eq - p_CW^raw, etc.). Residuals computed on all rows with complete raw+eq columns: (i) |sum of recovered flip probs - 1|; (ii) max excursion of any recovered flip prob outside [0,1]; (iii) max abs difference between the duplicated raw columns (_x vs _y merge legs).
conclusion: All residuals on the evaluated rows are at float32 storage precision (max sum deviation 2.04e-7, ~1.7x float32 eps, as expected from the 2*p_eq - p_raw arithmetic on float32-quantized columns). ZERO rows violate the identity beyond 1e-3 (and zero beyond 1e-6 if so reported below); the previously quoted "1.3% of rows violate beyond 1e-3" figure is NOT reproduced on the committed catalog and is superseded by this recompute. No QC flag or row exclusion is required and the HC dipole sample is unaffected.
